sources.title: On scalable oversight with weak LLMs judging strong LLMs — quoted full-text passages (arXiv 2407.04622v2 PDF)

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: Using LLMs both as agents and as weaker stand-in judges across extractive, closed and multimodal tasks, the paper reports that debate outperforms assigned-role consultancy on all tasks; against direct question answering, debate wins on extractive QA with information asymmetry but results are mixed on tasks without it. It also reports that when agents choose which answer to argue, judges are less often convinced of the wrong answer in debate than in consultancy, and that stronger debaters raise judge accuracy, though more modestly than in earlier studies.
title: Weak LLM judges: debate beats consultancy on all tasks, but vs direct QA results are mixed
